newsitem.title: USA: MBIA unit acquires 95 pct of Phila. firm.
newsitem.headline: MBIA unit acquires 95 pct of Phila. firm.

text.p: MBIA Inc said Friday its subsidiary, Strategic Services Inc, acquired a 95 percent interest in the Municipal Tax Bureau of Philadelphia, the country's largest provider of tax compliance services to state and local governments.
Boston Capital Corp acquired the remaining five percent of MTB, MBIA said.
MTB provides clients with tax collection and administration services, and out-of-state enforcement programs.
The company, founded in 1993, serves more than 40 state and local governments in Ala., Del., Fla., Mich., N.J., Okla., Pa., W.Va., and Washington, D.C.
